name: Mangoway
product: Mangoway is a personalized food scanner. You answer a quiz about your diet, allergies and the things you react to, and it checks scanned products against YOUR rules instead of giving a generic health score - so you stop guessing what to buy.
oneLiner: Mangoway is a personalized food scanner. You answer a quiz about your diet, allergies and the things you react to, and it checks scanned products against YOUR rules instead of giving a generic health score - so you stop guessing what to buy.
whatItIs: Mangoway is a personalized food scanner. You answer a quiz about your diet, allergies and the things you react to, and it checks scanned products against YOUR rules instead of giving a generic health score - so you stop guessing what to buy.
audience: People who feel bad after eating and do not know which ingredient is doing it - bloating, breakouts, low energy - plus adults with allergies or intolerances (gluten, lactose, dairy, peanuts), parents shopping for an allergic child, and anyone cutting additives or added sugar. The recurring pain is label anxiety: small print in the aisle, hidden names for the same ingredient, recipes changing on products you have bought for years.
voice: respects what the reader already knows
voiceTags: respects what the reader already knows
aesthetic: clean and high contrast, real supermarket packaging, legible label close-ups, clear flagged and cleared states, minimal chrome
niche: food scanning / allergen and ingredient checking app
do: name the exact aisle, menu or lunchbox moment; show a real label; be specific about which ingredient and why it matters; report what a scan found rather than what it guarantees; keep the app to one middle-slide cameo
dont: never call a product safe or allergen-free, no medical or diagnostic advice, no fear-mongering about additives, no moralising about food choices, never imply the app removes the need to read the label
